name: RPG Map Editor Test
description: GUI test of the RPG map editor (model v2) on rpg_plus_game: the palette lists the four shapes, the projection toggles during editing, a surface and a segment are painted, a sprite is placed, dragged to another cell and deleted, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y work, a collision cell and the spawn point are set; a new map is made with + and saved, and the game knows its map and scene at once. The demo map is never saved; every file of the mod is compared with its text afterwards and the new map's files are deleted. Activated by --itest=rpg_editor_edit with --game=rpg_plus --new (--editor-renderer=isometric starts in the isometric projection).
